status: Selected nominal fabrication features screen within published limits; factory DFM and assembly preparation remain open.

profile.outline: 160x70mm capsule, as checked by mechanical gate

scopeLimits: Trace width and via/slot dimensions are extracted directly. Copper spacing and edge clearance rely on the recorded native DRC and project rules, not an independent Gerber geometry engine.
No actual PCB, stencil or factory tooling has been inspected.
Only named features are screened; this is not a comprehensive factory DFM approval.
The PCB project allows a 0.05mm minimum via annulus, but actual vias are 0.15mm; this screen checks actual geometry rather than accepting that permissive setting.

assemblyPreparation.action: Have assembler propose/approve rails, optical fiducials, tooling and depanelization for this capsule. Keep attachments away from USB/card access and display supports; do not assume a bare-board Gerber is an assembly panel.

silkLegibilityReview.action: Review these reference markings in the fabrication preview; these are legibility advisories, not established electrical faults. Board-level artwork/graphics are outside this text scan.

sources.limitsUsed: 2-layer 1oz track/space 0.10/0.10mm; routed edge copper 0.2mm; plated slot width 0.5mm, length at least twice width. Profile includes conservative 0.13mm annular-ring screen.

sources.scope: Standard assembly requires rail/fiducial preparation; supplier must approve the actual implementation.
